states.name: socialist-governments
states.description: USSR plays Socialist Governments: remove 3 US influence from Western Europe, at most 2 per country. France holds US 3, Italy US 1, West Germany US 5, Poland US 2 (not Western Europe). USSR chooses.

states.name: comecon
states.description: USSR plays Comecon: +1 USSR in each of 4 non-US-controlled Eastern European countries. Poland is US-controlled (US 5), so it is excluded. USSR chooses.

states.name: warsaw-pact
states.description: USSR plays Warsaw Pact Formed. Mode 1 removes all US influence from 4 Eastern European countries (East Germany US 2, Poland US 3, Hungary US 1, Romania US 1, Bulgaria US 2, Czechoslovakia none); mode 2 adds 5 USSR, max 2 per country. USSR chooses.

states.name: truman-doctrine
states.description: US plays Truman Doctrine: remove all USSR influence from ONE uncontrolled European country. Italy has USSR 1 (uncontrolled); Greece USSR 2 and Poland USSR 3 are USSR-controlled, so not eligible. US chooses.

states.name: truman-doctrine-nothing-to-do
states.description: US plays Truman Doctrine with no uncontrolled European country holding USSR influence: the event resolves at once, changing nothing.

states.name: independent-reds
states.description: US plays Independent Reds: raise US influence to the USSR's in ONE of Yugoslavia/Romania/Bulgaria/Hungary/Czechoslovakia. Romania US 1 / USSR 3; Hungary US 2 / USSR 1 (already ahead). US chooses.

states.name: marshall-plan
states.description: US plays Marshall Plan: +1 US in each of 7 non-USSR-controlled Western European countries. West Germany is USSR-controlled (USSR 5), so it is excluded. US chooses.

states.name: suez-crisis
states.description: USSR plays Suez Crisis: remove 4 US influence from France, the UK and Israel, max 2 per country. France US 3, UK US 1, Israel US 4. USSR chooses.

states.name: east-european-unrest-early
states.description: US plays East European Unrest in the Early War (turn 1): remove 1 USSR influence from each of 3 Eastern European countries. US chooses.

states.name: east-european-unrest-late
states.description: The same position in the Late War (turn 8): remove 2 USSR influence from each of 3 countries (Romania/Bulgaria only have 1 to lose). US chooses.

states.name: decolonization
states.description: USSR plays Decolonization: +1 USSR in each of 4 countries in Africa and/or Southeast Asia. USSR chooses.

states.name: de-stalinization
states.description: USSR plays De-Stalinization: move up to 4 USSR influence from anywhere to non-US-controlled countries, max 2 added per country. Poland USSR 3, Czechoslovakia USSR 2; Canada is US-controlled (US 5). A 'may' card. USSR chooses.

states.name: south-african-unrest
states.description: USSR plays South African Unrest. Mode 1: +2 USSR in South Africa. Mode 2: +1 in South Africa and +2 in one adjacent country (Angola or Botswana). USSR chooses.

states.name: muslim-revolution
states.description: USSR plays Muslim Revolution: remove all US influence from 2 of Sudan/Iran/Iraq/Egypt/Libya/Saudi Arabia/Syria/Jordan. USSR chooses.

states.name: colonial-rear-guards
states.description: US plays Colonial Rear Guards: +1 US in each of 4 countries in Africa and/or Southeast Asia. US chooses.

states.name: puppet-governments
states.description: US plays Puppet Governments: +1 US in each of up to 3 countries with no US or USSR influence. Poland (USSR 1) and Italy (US 1) are excluded. A 'may' card. US chooses.

states.name: oas-founded
states.description: US plays OAS Founded: +2 US influence in any countries in Central and/or South America. US chooses.

states.name: liberation-theology
states.description: USSR plays Liberation Theology: +3 USSR in Central America, max 2 per country. USSR chooses.

states.name: the-reformer-behind
states.description: USSR plays The Reformer while BEHIND on VP (US +3): add 4 USSR influence to Europe, max 2 per country. USSR chooses.

states.name: the-reformer-ahead
states.description: USSR plays The Reformer while AHEAD on VP (USSR +3): add 6 USSR influence to Europe, max 2 per country. USSR chooses.

states.name: marine-barracks-bombing
states.description: USSR plays Marine Barracks Bombing: all US influence in Lebanon goes at once, then remove 2 more US influence from Middle East countries. Lebanon US 3, Israel US 2, Jordan US 1. USSR chooses.

states.name: special-relationship-uk-us-controlled
states.description: US plays Special Relationship with the UK US-controlled (US 5): +1 US in one country adjacent to the UK (Canada, Norway, Benelux, France). NATO isn't implemented, so only this branch exists. US chooses.

states.name: special-relationship-uk-not-controlled
states.description: US plays Special Relationship with the UK NOT US-controlled: nothing to do, resolves at once.

states.name: voice-of-america
states.description: USSR holds 3 in Egypt, 1 in Cuba, 2 in Japan, and 2 in Poland (Europe, not eligible). The Voice of America removes 4 USSR influence outside Europe, at most 2 per country. US chooses.

states.name: pershing-ii
states.description: US holds 2 in France, UK, West Germany and Italy. Pershing II pays the USSR 1 VP and removes 1 US influence from each of 3 Western European countries. USSR chooses.

states.name: how-i-learned
states.description: DEFCON 4, USSR at 1 Military Op. How I Learned to Stop Worrying lets the player set DEFCON to any level and adds 5 Military Ops (capped at 5). USSR to act.

ussr: How I Learned to Stop Worrying

states.name: wargames-defcon-2
states.description: DEFCON 2, USSR leads on VP by 8 (vp -8). Wargames may end the game: the US gets 6 VP first (vp -2), so the USSR still wins on VP. USSR to act.

states.name: wargames-defcon-2-loses-lead
states.description: DEFCON 2, USSR leads on VP by 3 (vp -3). Ending the game gives the US 6 VP (vp +3), so the US wins. USSR to act.

states.name: wargames-defcon-3
states.description: DEFCON 3: Wargames does nothing. USSR to act.

states.name: junta
states.description: US to act holding Junta (2 ops). The event adds 2 US influence to one country in Central or South America, then allows a free coup or realignment (not placement) in those regions only. Brazil holds USSR 2; Egypt (outside the Americas) holds USSR 2.
